overview: Field called from his own shop with a book he did not print. It came from Cambridge yesterday. He will not tell you the word in the margin. Harrison has copies at the Greyhound. Tomorrow at ten, at Paul's. Your jaw is the size of an egg. Woburn burned on Saturday, and a tract is already in the press. You said you would write to Quiney tonight. He asked for his Holinshed, and you ended on God keep thee.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Asked if the margin abused him, promised the letter, and did not answer the book.

parties.name: Richard Field
parties.context: Named himself and his shop, withheld the word, and asked for the Holinshed.
